Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. The Windies have levelled the series and we now go to Grenada for the third ODI. That match will be played on 25th February at 0930 local (1330 GMT). Join us for that one. Till then, cheers!

Windies' skipper, Jason Holder says he is really pleased and credits his boys for putting up a great performance. States that Hetmyer played really well and took them to a competitive total. Singles out Cottrell's spell to be the game-changer. Mentions those early wickets gave them momentum and then his twin wicket over once again got them back into the game. On being asked about Shimron Hetmyer's performance, Holder replies that it is really good to see young players step up to the occasion and feels Hetmyer has been a big player at such a young age for the country. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support.

Man of the Match, Shimron Hetmyer says he just wanted to keep going and rotate the strike. States that he and Bravo planned to see how deep they can go and were trying to rotate the strike as much as possible. On his improvement on playing both sides of the pitch, the young batter said he was just trying to work it on both sides of the ground. Adds that it's work in progress for him and he is continuing to learn and progress. Insists that he does not want to be a one-dimensional player. On being asked how was the mood in the team before they came out on the field, he replies that the mood was good as usual and they just wanted to do things according to the plan. On his celebration after the century, Hetmyer said it was nothing big but just something for his girlfriend.

England's skipper, Eoin Morgan says that he always knew it was going to go right till the end. Believes they did a lot of good things today. Says they fielded well and bowled well. States that they were going good with the bat but could not capitalize on it. On facing Sheldon Cottrell, the English skipper replies that it was his first time facing him and it was a very different challenge. Mentions he swings the ball in and he is a left-hander so it is difficult. Admits they failed to nail down the partnerships today and that cost them.

With the game slipping away from Windies, Jason Holder took the onus on himself and first removed the dangerous Ben Stokes from the crease. He didn't stop there and picked the wickets of Jos Buttler and Tom Curran off consecutive deliveries. That proved to be the match-turning moment and the home team just capitalized from thereon. The bearded boys, Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid, put up a fight for a while but once again Sheldon Cottrell returned to do the damage. He finished with a 5-wicket haul and played a key role in Windies' victory. Earlier in the day, Shimron Hetmyer stroked a fluent century and was instrumental in powering the home team's total to 289/6.

The chase started on a wrong note for England as they lost both their openers cheaply. Sheldon Cottrell was in his elements as he delivered initial blows to the Englishmen. Post that, Root and Morgan stitched in a handy stand followed by a 99-run partnership between the English skipper and Ben Stokes. Both the batsmen looked set to see the touring team home but then Cottrell was brought back into the attack and he dismissed Morgan. The depth in England's batting meant that they kept the upper hand as yet another vital alliance was formed between Buttler and Stokes. The real action though unfolded from there...

Windies have done it! They have broken the deadlock, their first win over England in ODIs since 2014. In between, they experienced 10 losses in a row. What a turnaround from them! This game swung like a pendulum. Both teams kept bouncing back whenever put under pressure but eventually it was the home team landing the knockout punch. A very entertaining game for the crowd and the series is now levelled 1-1!

OUT! Caught in the deep! Brathwaite picks up the last wicket. Full length delivery on off, Plunkett looks to power it over long off but ends up giving it straight to the fielder. Jason Holder there takes a very simple catch and roars in celebration. WINDIES WIN BY 26 RUNS!
Shorter in length outside off, Mark cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Full length delivery on the leg. It is going down with the angle. Wood looks to hit it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Yorker on middle, Plunkett gets his bat down and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and outside off, cut from the back foot but straight to point. Another fine over by Sheldon, grabbing two wickets and giving away just 2 runs.
Mark Wood comes in at number 11.

OUT! Bowled round the legs! Moeen departs. A body blow to England and the crowd erupts. Cottrell serves a length ball down the leg side, Moeen fails to flick and it deflects onto the stumps after clipping the inside of his thigh pad. Sheldon is absolutely delighted, his maiden 5-wicket haul in ODIs. Take our salute, boy!
Edgy! Good length ball on middle and off, Plunkett tries to cover the line and defend but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man for a single.
Liam Plunkett is the new man in for England.

OUT! Caught behind! Fourth wicket for Cottrell and his wonderful night continues. Delivers a back of a length delivery on off and gets some extra bounce. Rashid tries running it down but gets a thick outside edge behind. Shai Hope makes no mistake and it's time for another salute from Sheldon. 30 needed off 21 balls.
Once again the length is a touch short outside off, Rashid pushes it from the back foot to point.
A touch short and angling into the batsman, Moeen turns inside the crease and pulls it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Swing and a miss. Length delivery outside off, Adil looks to hit it but misses. Good comeback from Brathwaite. Finishes off with 2 dot balls in a row.
Better from Brathwaite. Length delivery outside off. Rashid pushes at it and misses.

FOUR! Two-in-two. Pressure back on the bowler. Good length delivery on the pads, Rashid flicks it towards backward square leg and the fielder from deep square leg gives it a chase but fails to cut it off.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Overpitched delivery outside off, Rashid drives it through point and the ball races away to the fence.
Yorker length on middle and off, Rashid looks to flick but it comes off the bottom edge. Rashid comes forward for a single but Moeen sends him back.
Full length delivery outside off, Ali hits it towards deep cover and gets only a single.
Carlos Brathwaite back into the attack.
Reaches out for a full ball outside off and drives it square of the wicket on the off side. A couple taken. 7 from the over, 40 needed off 30 balls.
Wide! Sprays a length ball wide outside off, Adil allows it through. The umpire stretches his arms.
A length ball on middle and leg, angling in, Moeen closes the face of his bat and helps it through mid-wicket for one.
Wide! An attempted slower one goes down the leg side, Moeen tries to sweep but misses.
Nicely played. Good length ball on middle and off, Rashid plays at it late and deflects it down to third man for a run.
Beaten! Cottrell bowls a sharp one. Angles it away from the batsman, on a length, Adil throws his bat at it but fails to make any connection.
Shout for an lbw! A length ball on middle, straightening a bit after landing, Rashid tries to defend but gets an INSIDE EDGE onto the pads.
Back of a length delivery on off, Moeen punches it down to long on and takes a run.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on. 47 needed off 36 balls.
A cracking yorker, right in the blockhole, Adil is equally up to the task as he digs it out. Holder bowls out, 10-1-53-3, brilliant work done by him.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Valuable runs for England. Holder errs in his line and serves a length ball down the leg side. Rashid gets a faint tickle behind it and the ball screams past Hope for a boundary.
A dipping yorker around leg, Ali eases it through mid-wicket and takes a single.
Slower one, angling away from the batsman outside off, Moeen opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards short third man.
Too full in length on the pads, it's whipped through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
On the stumps this time, Rashid defends it with a straight bat.

Dropped! Captain my captain. What have you done here? Flighted delivery on off, Moeen goes back to punch but does so uppishly at covers. It goes straight towards Jason Holder who puts down a sitter. He has his hands on his head and Bishoo cannot believe it!
Shorter in length, Rashid cuts it to the fielder at point.
Shorter delivery on off, Ali punches it off the back foot and hits it towards cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, Moeen defends it with a straight bat.

Flighted delivery on middle and leg. Moeen tucks it towards mid-wicket and goes for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. There is no one backing up so they get one more run. Two runs in all taken from that ball.

NOT OUT! Daylight! Windies just got carried away there. Now, the home team also has no review left. Back of a length delivery outside off, Rashid stays back to push inside the line but misses. The keeper collects the ball and Holder appeals along with Shai Hope. Not given and they take the DRS. The replays detect no wood. End of an eventful over, 2 runs and 2 wickets from it.

The Windies' players have gone upstairs for caught behind. They think they have got another wicket here. It looked to the naked eye like there was no bat involved but let's see what the Snicko has to say.
Yorker, Rashid does extremely well to dig it out at the last moment.
Adil Rashid walks in next.

OUT! Given lbw! Well, let me tell you, Tom Curran is very unlucky here. No DRS available for England and Holder is roaring now. A length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Curran tries to work it around but misses and is hit high on the pads. The appeal is made and the finger is up immediately. The replays show that it's clearly going down leg. A dejected Tom is on his way back. On a hat-trick, Jason...
Tom Curran is the new batsman.

OUT! What a big wicket for Windies. They have got back in the game. Slower delivery on length on off, Buttler initially looks to drive but then pulls out of it. He ends up going at it half-heartedly and chips it uppishly towards covers. Shimron Hetmyer takes a very simple catch. His second catch of the game.

Almost a run out. Good length delivery on middle, Ali tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets on his bike for a single. Oshane Thomas gets to the ball quickly. He dives picks up the ball and throws, all in one motion. His shy at the bowler's end misses. Had he hit, Ali was gone for all money.
Full toss on middle, Buttler flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Moeen moves back to cut but is cramped for room. Just about manages to keep it out at the last moment.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and hammers it down to long on for a run. Good again from Bishoo.
Too full in length on off, it's driven through the line but straight to the cover fielder.
Slower one, full and on middle, Moeen gently flicks it behind square leg and hands the strike back to Buttler.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Short and wide outside off, Buttler goes back and cuts it straight to point.
Moeen Ali arrives. This is a never-ending batting line-up. 62 needed off 60 balls.

OUT! Caught. He has hit the ball and Stokes has to walk back. Full length delivery outside off. It is pitched on the rough. Ben Stokes looks to hit it through the line but seems to have got an outside edge. The ball goes straight behind to Shai Hope who takes a regulation catch and jumps in joy. The keeper and bowler are up in celebration and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Stokes consults his partner and takes the review. The replays show that he hit the turf but before that it took the outside edge too. The Snicko confirms there was bat involved and the well-set Stokes walks back to the pavilion. He is fuming in anger on his way to the dressing room.

Ben Stokes is given out caught behind. Windies are celebrating but the English all-rounder is not going anywhere. He has a chat with his partner and takes the DRS. Has the bat hit the turf and not the ball?
Length delivery on the stumps, Ben taps it back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, Stokes cuts it wide of the point fielder and gets a brace.

SIX! Catch is the call from Holder but that is a crowd catch. Good length delivery on off and middle, Stokes gets on his back foot and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. The fielder in the deep there just sees it sail over the fence.
On middle and leg, Jos tucks it away towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Yorker length delivery on leg, Stokes gets his bat down in time and it takes the inside edge before going onto the pads. The ball goes towards the fine leg region and they take a single.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to covers. Dot ball to end a 7-run over. Only one bad ball really in it.
Buttler has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Off the arm! A leg spinner around off, turning away, Jos tries reverse sweeping it but misses.
SIX! Gone into the crowd! Just cannot bowl short to this batsman. An attempted googly by Bishoo but he lands it way too short. Buttler gets enough time to go back and rocket it over wide long on.
A conventional hit, across the line and with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
Hit hard but failed to beat short third man. A flatter and shorter ball on middle, Stokes reverse sweeps but not in the gap.
Wake up call. Shorter in length, Buttler looks to defend but it flicks his gloves and strikes him on his helmet before going behind to the keeper. No sign of danger as Buttler looks fine to continue.

Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Buttler looks to defend it but it comes off the lower half of his bat and bounces just over the stumps. Fortunately for Buttler it does not clip the stumps.
Slower delivery outside off, Buttler looks to hit it towards point but misses.

FOUR! Not from the middle but still gets the desired result. Full length delivery around off, Buttler lofts it over mid off. Ashley Nurse there is not at the edge of the circle, he is inside a bit. He jumps and tries to catch it but cannot get his hands to it and the ball goes away to the fence.
Good shot but only a single. Good length delivery on off, Ben lofts it over mid off and the ball reaches the long off fielder on a bounce.
Length delivery on the pads, Buttler flicks it away towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg. Ben looks to play it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Tidy over by Bishoo.
On the pads, Jos nudges it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Jos brings out the reverse sweep and connects but the fielder at point does well to stop it. No run taken.
Flatter delivery on off, Buttler hits it to the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Excellent shot.  Shorter in length from Bishoo. Buttler waits for it and punches it off his back foot through covers for a boundary. Jos has got going here.
Shorter delivery outside off, Buttler looks to play the reverse sweep but is unable to do so because of the extra bounce on it.
The line is straight, Jos moves inside the line and turns it off his pads through square leg. Wants two but will have to satisfy with a run. 10 from the over.
Angles in a length ball on off, Buttler gets across and works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
The reserve umpire is out with a bag of balls.

SIX! This is a shot from a batsman known for clean hitting. Holder overpitches around off, Buttler brings down a straight bat and launches it over the bowler's head. It crashes into the sightscreen and seems to have lost its shape. No, in fact they have lost it. New ball please...

Slower one, an off cutter around leg, some extra bounce as well. Stokes tries flicking but is surprised by the extra lift. It takes the leading edge and lobs in the air towards the vacant extra cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fine leg drops back and third man comes up...

Fine shot and a good piece of fielding by Campbell. A length ball angling down the leg side, Stokes picks it off his pads and flicks it over backward square leg. Campbell in the deep puts in a good run before diving and stopping the ball. Saves two.
Pitches it up and outside off, it's stroked sweetly down to long off for a run. Under 100 needed now.
Jason Holder brings himself into the attack.
Shorter in length around off, the southpaw takes a single by punching it wide of the cover fielder. 100 runs more required off 90 balls. Windies need wickets here to tighten the screws on England.
Flighted on middle and leg, Jos flicks it to the on side and rotates the strike.
Once again on the pads. Stokes nudges it towards mid-wicket and churns out a single.
On the pads from Bishoo, Jos tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Flighted delivery on off. Buttler brings out the reverse sweep and hits it towards deep backward point for a couple.

Beautiful from Bishoo. Leg spinner pitching on off, Buttler stretches out to drive it but misses. Hope takes the bails off in a flash and puts in a stifled appeal. The square leg umpire does not even bother taking it upstairs and signals it not out.
Devendra Bishoo to bowl again.

FOUR! This time towards the leg side. Shorter delivery by Brathwaite, Stokes rocks onto his back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball bounces before the rope and goes away for a boundary. Stokes clearly is winning this battle against Brathwaite.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Length delivery around off, Stokes comes down the track and hits it through covers. The fielder there puts in a dive to his right but has no chance of saving that.
On the pads, Buttler tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Wide. Bouncer bounces too high and goes over Jos' head. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Stokes nudges it towards long on and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length, Ben comes down the pitch and hits it to the fielder at mid off with a slanted-bat.
Good length delivery on off, Stokes taps it back to the bowler.
Bowls it on a length, Ben punches it towards cover and keeps the strike.

Brilliant running. Back of a length delivery on off and middle, Buttler gets on top of the bounce and defends it with soft hands. The ball goes behind on the off side and Stokes calls for a quick single. He is fast between the wickets and gets there with ease.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, this time Stokes is able to punch it towards long on and rotate the strike.
Back of a length delivery around off, Ben punches it to the fielder at cover.

Great commitment. Good length delivery on middle, Stokes flicks it wide of the fielder at mid-wicket. Carlos Brathwaite there makes use of his long strides and dives to his right to save runs for his side.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Stokes guides it to the fielder at mid-wicket.

Drinks break. 120 needed off 108 balls. This match is still in favour of England. Ben Stokes holds the key from hereon as for the new batsmen coming in, it won't be easy to start playing shots from the word go. Windies have done well to hang in there but they need wickets at regular intervals as the Englishmen bat very deep. We're heading for a tight finish.
A length ball on middle, Ben brings down a straight bat and punches it to long on for one.
FOUR! 14th ODI fifty for Ben Stokes. He gets there with a fine pull shot. Receives a gentle short ball in his half and has no qualms in sending it behind square leg for a boundary.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Stokes allows it through.
The batsman has played it to the point region. No run.
Pitches it up on off, it's driven off the front foot to covers.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Buttler tries to flick but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to the leg side and they cross. A stifled appeal from the bowler dies down quickly.
Streaky! Fullish and angling in on middle, Stokes tries to flick but it takes the leading edge and runs down to third man for a run
Pitches it on a length on the stumps, Buttler blocks it to see off the over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ben punches it towards covers and takes a single.
In the air but safe. Length delivery outside off, Buttler looks to cut it and does so but uppishly. Luckily for him, it is wide of the fielder at point and they are able to take a single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Ben nudges it towards long on and gets to the other end.
Jos Buttler replaces his skipper.

OUT! The 99-run stand has been broken! Cottrell strikes back. Full length delivery on middle and leg, Morgan looks to heave it over mid-wicket. He is early into his shot and gets no timing on it. The ball goes high up in the air and Shimron Hetmyer comes running forward from the deep and dives in front to take a great catch. Ashley Nurse is a relieved man here, as he had dropped Morgan earlier. The English skipper misses out on a well-deserved century but he has put his team in control. They need 131 more runs off 118 balls.
Slower delivery fuller in length. It is on middle and leg, Stokes hits it towards long on and gets to the other end.
Stokes comes down the track and hits this shorter delivery towards deep cover for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Ben punches it off his back foot to the fielder at cover.

FOUR! Edgy but they will take it. Good length delivery outside off, the ball moves away slightly after pitching. Stokes looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies past the keeper and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Ben pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Stokes comes down the track, Brathwaite sees it and bowls it short. Ben adjusts to it in time and hits it towards the mid off fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, Stokes punches it towards the cover fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, Ben punches it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
On off, Ben cuts it to point.
Again lands it on leg, Ben works it to deep square leg and runs for a second.
On leg, Morgan flicks it to square leg and takes a single. 150 up for the Englishmen.
FOUR! Full toss on off. It's punched off by Morgan through covers. The ball races to the fence.
Sheldon Cottrell is back into the attack.
A back foot punch by Stokes to mid off where Gayle makes a fine diving stop. Dot ball to end the over.
Bowls a shortish ball close to off stump, Morgan plays it down in the gap at cover-point and rotates the strike.
The line is quite straight and Stokes turns it off his pads to deep mid-wicket for one.
Gets behind the line and taps a length ball towards backward point. Looks for a run but is sent back.
Back of a length ball on off, Stokes stays back and pushes it outer half of his bat to cover-point.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to sweeper cover. They pick up a single.
Carlos Brathwaite to have a go now.
Ben flicks the length delivery to mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, Stokes reverse sweeps it to short third man.
Stokes punches it to mid-wicket but finds the fielder.
On leg, Morgan sweeps it to deep square leg and takes a run.
On thigh pad, Ben works it to fine leg and picks a single.
Slower one on middle, Stokes pushes it to mid-wicket.
Flighted one outside off, going straight on, Eoin shoulders arms. 11 from the over!
Very full on off, Moggie keeps it out to covers.
Wide! Serves it too wide outside off, Morgan allows it through.
Short and pulled but not in the gap on the leg side.
Goes back and punches it through the line. Carlos Brathwaite dives across to his right at short extra cover to make the stop.
SIX! And this one has gone all the way! Gayle overdoes his length on this occasion, it's short and on off, Morgan turns inside the crease and muscles his pull shot over square leg.
FOUR! Boom! Too full in length and outside off, Morgan strides forward and drills his cover drive for a boundary. Really hitting those hard.
Shorter on leg, Stokes works it to the leg side.

Dropped! Has Ashley Nurse dropped the match here? Bishoo lands it outside leg, Morgan reverse sweeps it but it goes uppishly towards short third man. Nurse stationed there dives to his left and gets his hands to the ball but it pops out. He drops the English skipper. Now then, can Morgan make full use of it?
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.

Fifty for the skipper, back-to-back in this series! Shorter delivery around off, Eoin punches it through covers and gets a brace to bring up his 43rd ODI fifty. A very crucial knock from Morgan here but he knows the job is not done yet. He will look to convert this to a big one and see his side home.
Flatter on leg, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
On middle, Morgan sweeps it to square leg and takes a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Quicker and flatter on middle, stroked to long off for another run.
Another front foot drive down to long off for one.
Stretches forward to a full ball and drives it past the short cover fielder for a single.
Slips one down the leg side, Ben sees it through. The keeper fumbles but no extra run taken. Not a wide. Maybe, it clipped his pads.
Quicker and fuller ball on off, Stokes lunges in defense.
Chris Gayle into the attack now.
Flighted on off, Stokes hits it towards covers and takes a single. He keeps the strike for the start of the next over.
On the pads, Morgan flicks it away to the leg side for a single.
Flighted delivery on the pads, Morgan looks to defend but it hits his pads and lobs up. Shai Hope catches the ball but no appeal from anyone.
Once again Bishoo lands it short on off, Ben hits it towards long on and gets a single.
Shorter in length around off, Stokes hits it to the fielder at mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Daylight there! A delivery sliding down the leg side and Stokes tries to flick. He fails to middle his shot and the keeper gets excited after collecting the ball. He appeals along with the bowler and the finger goes up. Stokes is quick to take the referral and the Ultra Edge shows no wood.
Ben Stokes has been given out caught behind! He's quick to take the DRS which indicates that there was no edge. Let's see...
On middle, Morgan helps a pull to mid-wicket and take a single.
SIX! High and handsome! Nurse overpitches and lands it full on middle, Stokes kneels and smokes it over mid-wicket for a biggie. With the wind she goes. 50-run stand comes up!
Fires one on middle, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and blocks it to the off side.
Full and on off, hit down the ground to long off for one.
Goes down to play the reverse sweep, makes good connection but finds short third man.
Gets on the front foot and drives it down to long off for a run.
Quicker one, landing full on off and skidding in, Stokes tries to reverse sweep but misses.
Flatter delivery pitching on leg, Morgan looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the mid-riff region.
Loopy delivery on middle and off, Stokes sweeps it towards square leg and gets a single.
Flighted again on middle and leg, Stokes looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, Stokes defends it off his front foot.
Once again Morgan looks for a reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball goes to the on side and they steal a single.

Slower leg spinner on middle and off, Morgan looks to reverse sweep it but misses. It comes off his arm. The bowler and the keeper appeal first for the lbw then for the catch. They think about the review but decide otherwise.
Flighted on off, Stokes reaches to the ball and defends it off on front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Dropped! Fullish on off, Morgan drives it hard and uppishly to covers. Hetmyer was standing right in front to catch that one. He dives across to his left but somehow fumbles due to the pace on the ball. The batsmen run for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flighted on off, Ben cuts it to point and takes a single.
Outside off, driven to mid off by Stokes.
Strokes this one straight and past his partner to long on. A run to end the over. 11 from Bishoo's first.
Flatter through the air, a bit short around off and turning in, Stokes hits it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Crunched! Bishoo switches to 'round the wicket and lets out a short ball outside off, Ben rocks back and hammers it through extra cover. The leggie has been targeted here. 100 up for England.
Stays back to a short ball and punches it through covers for a brace.
Tossed up ball on middle, Stokes gets on the front foot and defends it to the leg side.

FOUR! A bit edgy, this! Bishoo bowls a leg spinner on the shorter side outside off. It doesn't turn much as Stokes goes back to punch it through the line. But it takes a thick outside edge and runs through backward point for a boundary.
Devendra Bishoo to roll his arm now. A slip in place...
Around off, Ben drives it to long on. One added to the total with this run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On off, Morgan drives it to mid off and will take a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On leg, Stokes drives it to mid on and picks a single.
Flighted on middle, Stokes pushes it to covers.

SIX! This one has gone the distance. Morgan is not going to back down from playing the pull shot. This time the 'round the wicket angle of the bowler worked in his favour. It's short on middle and leg, Eoin swivels on the back foot and pummels it over backward square leg for a flat biggie. 12 from the over. 5-0-32-1, so far from Oshane. Has been expensive just like the first game.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A rising delivery on off, Stokes drags his attempted pull shot on the leg side.
Width on offer outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a run.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Fighting fire with fire. Thomas serves a sharp short ball around off at 143.5 kph, Morgan immediately gets on top of the bounce and plays a thunderous pull shot for a boundary at mid-wicket.
On leg and middle, Morgan drives it to mid on and will keep the strike for the next over.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, the batsman cuts it to point.
Flighted on off, Morgan hits it back to the bowler.
On leg, Eoin flicks it to square leg and picks a couple.
SIX! Tonk! Shorter on middle, Morgan immediately drops his weight on the back leg and pulls it handsomely over mid-wicket for a biggie. Great start to the over.
Drinks break. Windies are doing well here. They have hunted down three top order English wickets and are trying to build pressure. Just cannot afford to relax given England's batting depth.
FOUR! Exquisite. Over pitched delivery on off, Stokes gets on his front foot and drives it straight through mid off for a boundary. Wonderfully timed by Stokes. This will get him going.
Once again a back of a length delivery, Eoin pulls it away and gets off strike.
Bouncer. On leg, Morgan gets away from it and lets it go to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Morgan gets on top of the bounce and defends it off his back foot.
Shorter in length, Stokes pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark.
Length delivery on the pads, Morgan looks to flick it but misses. The ball goes off his thigh pad and they take a single. The umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Flatter on middle, Stokes front foot defenses it.
On the pad, Eoin flicks it away to square leg and pick up a single.
Around off, Morgan drives the ball down the ground.
On leg, Morgan defends it confidently.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lands it outside off, Morgan looks to defend but the ball takes an outside edge and makes it on one bounce to Gayle at first slip.
Ben Stokes walks out to the middle.

OUT! Caught. Oshane Thomas has given Windies a big breakthrough here. Back of a length delivery outside off at 143 kph. Joe Root teases this one, looking to cut it over point by leaning back. But probably due to the excessive pace, he gets a thin outside edge to it and the ball goes behind to the keeper. Shai Hope takes a regulation catch. The Windies' players are up in celebration and so is the crowd here in Barbados. Joe Root, who was looking so good out in the middle, has to walk back and the 50-run partnership has been broken.
Around off, Root drives it to mid off.
FOUR! A length ball on middle, Root pulls it away to deep mid-wicket and bags a boundary. 50-run partnership comes up off 66 balls.
Outside off, the batsman pushes it to point. Another dot ball.
Good length and around off, Root guides it to point.
Fullish on off, Root drives it to mid off.
Shorter in length from Nurse. This one spins in towards the batsman. Root comes down the track and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads this time, Morgan tucks it away towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length outside off, Joe punches it towards covers and takes a single.

Excellent delivery. Tossed up delivery which pitches on the rough. The ball spins in towards the batsman and beats Root who was looking to hit it on the off side. It bounces high as well and the keeper cannot collect it.
Flighted delivery around off, Morgan pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
Tossed up delivery down the leg side, Root gets on one knee and sweeps it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Ashley Nurse is on now.
Back of a length, Joe pulls it away towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Full length delivery pitching outside off, Morgan looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits him on his pads and goes on the leg side. They take a run and the umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Shorter in length, Joe pulls it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, Morgan flicks it away towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Root guides it away towards third man and takes a single.
FOUR! Classical straight drive. Full length delivery on off, Root drives it straight and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary in no time.
Powerplay 2 begins. Maximum of 4 fielders can now be outside the circle till the 40th over.
Sprays it on the 5th stump line, Morgan offers no shot.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
On middle and leg, Root flicks this away to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
On leg, Root works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Root hits this one in style. Back of a length and on middle, Root gets to his back foot and helps it pull shot over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and on off, Morgan defends it to covers and runs for a single.
Length delivery on off, Joe pushes it to the fielder at point. Good start from Thomas, just 2 runs off his first over.
Good length delivery outside off, Joe looks to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Shimron Hetmyer is down injured and the physios are out to have a look at him. Not sure whether it is a cramp or pull. Not a good sign this for Windies. He is being taken off the field.

Good length delivery outside off, Root cuts it hard towards backward point. Hetmyer misfields it and the ball goes behind. The fielder at deep cover runs and collects it. The batsmen meanwhile get a brace.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Joe rocks onto his back foot and defends it.
Back of a length delivery, Root pushes it to the fielder at point.
Starts with a good length delivery on the stumps, Root taps it back to the bowler.
First change in bowling. Oshane Thomas replaces Sheldon Cottrell.
On the pads, the left-hander flicks it to mid-wicket. Excellent over again from Holder. A maiden this time.
This time bowls it closer to the off pole, Morgan looks to defend but misses.
On the 5th stump line, Morgan leaves it alone.
Around off, Morgan drives it to covers.
On off, Morgan works it to mid-wicket from the back foot.
Morgan has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter delivery to end the over. Morgan pulls it away towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Back of a length around off, Root guides it towards third man and takes a single.
Good length delivery outside ff, Root pushes it to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Morgan punches it wide of the cover fielder and takes a single.
FOUR! Exquisite. Overpitched deliver on middle and off, Morgan just drives it wide of the diving fielder and through mid off for a boundary. The skipper holds his pose for the cameras.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball shapes away slighlty from the batsman. Morgan looks to defend but misses.
On off, Root defends that one off his back foot. Just 2 runs came off this over. Really good over from the skipper.
Outside off, Morgan cuts it to third man and rotates the strike.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide. Bowls it outside the tramline on off. Morgan swings at it but fails to put bat on ball.
On the 4th stump line, the batsman pushes it to point.
Good length on leg, Morgan defends it to leg side.
On thigh pad to the left-hander, Morgan keeps it out.
Yorker on middle, Joe gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Length delivery around off, Morgan guides it towards covers and takes a run.
On middle and leg, Root follows the boundary with a single by tucking it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Just pure timing. Slower delivery outside off. Cottrell serves it full and Root drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Joe drives it handsomely but straight to the fielder at point.
Length delivery on off, Root jumps and defends it with a straight bat.
FOUR! Width on offer by Holder, Morgan front foot drives it through covers and finds a boundary. A good comeback in the over by the England's skipper.
Bowls it outside off but this time it is inside the tramline. Morgan leaves it thinking for a wide again.
Wide. Bowls it wide on offside. It is been wided by the umpire.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, Morgan looks to play at it first then pulls his bat back.
Again a length delivery, this time on the pads. Morgan defends it.
Back of a length on middle, Morgan defends it to off side.

Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Morgan looks to defend but gets an inside edge. The ball goes to the on side and they take a single. Another brilliant over from Cottrell. 4 runs and a wicket off his second over.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Morgan defends it off his back foot.
Wide! Length delivery too far outside off stump, Eoin leaves it alone and the umpire signals it as wide.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Morgan leaves it alone.
Length delivery on off, Root pushes it towards mid off and gets a run.
On middle and leg, Morgan flicks it away towards mid-wicket and gets a single. The skipper is off the mark.
England's skipper, Eoin Morgan walks out at number 4.

OUT! Bowled 'em. Cottrell is on fire and England lose their second wicket. Good length delivery outside off, Roy looks to play it on the off side by reaching out for it. He gets a big inside edge and the ball goes onto hit the middle stump. The centurion from last game departs cheaply this time. The crowd is going bonkers here and Sheldon Cottrell once again brings out his trademark salute celebration.
Good length targeting Root's pad, he looks to flick but the ball brushes off his thigh pad and makes it to the keeper. A stifled appeal, turned down by the umpire.
On the 4th stump line, Root chooses to leave it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Root has it all decided. Holder bowls a short ball on off, Root pulls it sharp through square leg and gets a boundary.
On off, Roy looks to defend but the ball goes to on side from an inside edge. One run added to the total.
Good length on the 4th stump line, Roy shoulder arms to it.
Jason Holder to partner Cottrell with the second new ball.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Joe leaves it alone to see off the over. Bright start from Windies. 5 runs and a wicket off the first over.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Good length delivery outside off, Root sees the width and cuts it through point for a boundary. Joe continuing from where he left in the previous game.
Length delivery on the stumps, Root defends it off his back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Root starts his innings with a watchful leave.
Joe Root walks in at number 3.

OUT! What a start for Windies. Full length delivery on middle and leg. The ball moves back in after pitching. Bairstow was looking to flick it but misses as his bat comes down late and the ball hits him on his back pad. The Windies' players think they have got their man and they go up in a huge appeal. The umpire is in agreement with them and raises the dreaded finger. Cottrell brings out his famous salute celebration as Bairstow walks back.
Cottrell starts with a length delivery on the pads, Roy flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single. First run on the board for England straightaway.
We are back for the chase. Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow walk out to the middle to open the innings for England. Sheldon Cottrell to take the first new ball for Windies.
